notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a real Chrome UA) worked for the entire site; robots.txt allows all crawlers (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow), so no tier escalation was needed. TREE: built from union of robots.txt/sitemap.xml -> categorySitemap-en.xml (8344 category URLs, filtered to /en/home-decor* and to the SSR mega-menu on the home-decor--6770, bathroom--6823, bedding--6785, decor--6771, kitchen-dining--6803, rugs--8413 and furniture--9867 pages, which are all server-rendered with real <a href> links). Confirmed each recorded leaf's own <link rel=canonical> and (h1 or the categoryFiltersList-title panel label, used when h1 was a generic marketing string) matched the requested URL. QTY: taken from the rendered categoryFilters-productCount span ("Filter and sort (N)") on each leaf's own page - this is the site's own exact count, not estimated. EXCLUDED (parent rolled up into a leaf split only when the split's counts summed close to the parent, i.e. a true non-overlapping product-type partition; kept the parent count when the split counts summed to well over 100% of the parent, i.e. cross-cutting attribute filters, not real subcategories): Curtains solid/patterned/sheer/blackout/hidden-tab/grommet/extra-long sub-tiles (sum 179 vs parent 105 - overlapping opacity/heading-style/length facets) -> kept parent 'Curtains & Drapes' only. Sheets & Pillowcases material/pattern/pillowcases sub-tiles (sum 237 vs parent 120) -> kept parent only. Bath Towels solid/patterned sub-tiles -> kept parent 145 only (beach-towels leaf returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge, could not verify exhaustiveness of any split, so parent used as-is). Accent Rugs and Area Rugs 'up to WxH' size tiles (Area Rugs: 355+272+258=885 vs parent 400) -> confirmed non-exclusive filtered views of the same inventory, kept parent Accent/Area Rugs only. Kept as true leaf splits (sums close to parent, genuinely distinct product types): Duvet Covers/Comforters & Coverlets/Pillow Shams under 'Duvet Covers & Comforters' (60+15+43=118 vs 129); Fabric vs Vinyl Tablecloths (84+11=95 vs 107, vinyl excluded as non-textile material); Fabric/Paper/Napkin-Rings Table Napkins (75+26+4=105 vs 124, only Fabric kept, paper/rings excluded); Kitchen & Dish Towels vs Sponge Cloths under Tea Towels & Dishcloths (139+4=143 vs 167; Sponge Cloths are scouring sponges, not textile, excluded). Excluded nodes entirely: 'Vinyl Rugs' (80, PVC/vinyl mats, non-textile material per textile.md Sec16); 'Bathroom Accessories' aka accessories-wastebaskets--6835 (214, dominated by soap dishes/pumps/toothbrush holders/tumblers - decorative bathroom accessories, not genuine storage, out of scope); 'Kids Bedding Decor' (bedding/kids--8982, 67, canonical silently redirects to /en/kids/bedroom--6950, a mixed Kids-department room page combining children's furniture/chairs with bedding/rugs - not a clean textile-only node); 'Furniture > Storage' (furniture/storage--9883: shelves-bookshelves + buffet-console-tables, explicitly placed under the Furniture nav = Furniture task per storage.md Sec21, not Storage); 'Storage, Hooks & Shelves at Fabrique 1840' (9137, 52, sample titles dominated by decorative wall shelves/wall-mounted coat racks/hooks/trays = Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories territory, not genuine storage containment); 'bedding/mattress-covers--6801' and 'bathroom/bath-towels/beach-towels--6828' both returned Cloudflare managed-challenge pages (HTTP 403, cf_chl_tk token) on every attempt - treated as dead/inaccessible nav slugs and excluded, not chased further since the rest of the site (30+ other pages) was freely accessible via tier (a) with no block. Storage rows: 'Baskets & Storage' (decor/baskets-storage-items--8242, 144) is majority genuine storage/woven baskets with some decorative trays/a jewellery box mixed in - included at MEDIUM confidence. 'Bathroom Baskets & Storage' (bathroom/baskets-storage-items--9822, 189) sampled as majority decorative trays/jewellery boxes/wall hooks with some genuine baskets (e.g. a felted laundry basket) - included at LOW confidence per storage.md Sec42 ambiguity handling, flagged for manual review.
